name: Ollama
description: Trigger workflows when a local Ollama model is added, updated or loaded into memory, and chat, generate, embed, and list, show, pull, copy or delete models from a step.

triggers.label: A model was added or updated
triggers.description: Fires once per model build from GET /api/tags: a new name, or a pull that changed a digest. The first poll delivers every model present.

env.name: OLLAMA_HOST
env.description: The server origin, http://localhost:11434 by default. A trailing / or /api is stripped and a bare host:port gets http://.
env.builderHint: The same variable the ollama CLI reads. A hosted or proxied server that wants a key takes it from OLLAMA_API_KEY in the environment, sent as Authorization: Bearer; the SDK refuses a secret field on a connector that needs no sign-in, so there is no config field for it.

triggers.label: A model was loaded into memory
triggers.description: Fires when a model appears in GET /api/ps with an expiry not yet seen. Every request extends the expiry, so a busy model fires again on each poll; poll slowly.

env.name: OLLAMA_HOST
env.description: The server origin, http://localhost:11434 by default. A trailing / or /api is stripped and a bare host:port gets http://.
env.builderHint: The same variable the ollama CLI reads. A hosted or proxied server that wants a key takes it from OLLAMA_API_KEY in the environment, sent as Authorization: Bearer; the SDK refuses a secret field on a connector that needs no sign-in, so there is no config field for it.

actions.label: Chat
actions.description: Generate the next assistant message of a conversation with POST /api/chat. Every call runs a generation.

inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: The model name in model:tag form; the tag defaults to latest. listModels returns what is present.
inputs.builderHint: A name that is not on the server answers 404 and is reported as "not present; pull it first"; nothing is pulled on the caller's behalf.

inputs.label: Messages
inputs.description: A single user text, or a JSON array of { "role", "content" } with role system, user, assistant or tool.
inputs.builderHint: Text becomes [{ role: "user", content: text }]; a value starting with [ is parsed as the array and passed through, so images and tool_calls on a turn survive.

inputs.label: System prompt
inputs.description: Instructions for the model, kept apart from the conversation.
inputs.builderHint: On chat it is prepended as a system turn unless the messages already start with one; on generate it is sent as system.

inputs.label: Format
inputs.description: json for any valid JSON, or a JSON schema object the answer must match.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as format untouched. With a schema, also describe it in the prompt so the model grounds its answer; the reply is text, so parse content yourself.

inputs.label: Options
inputs.description: Runtime options such as { "temperature": 0.2, "num_predict": 256 }.
inputs.builderHint: Passed through as options: temperature, num_predict, seed, top_k, top_p, min_p, stop, num_ctx and any other Modelfile parameter.

inputs.label: Keep alive
inputs.description: How long the model stays loaded after the reply, such as 10m; 0 unloads it at once.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as keep_alive. A duration string or a number of seconds; a negative number keeps it loaded until the server stops.

outputs.description: The thinking text when the model produced one, else null
The tool_calls array when the model made any, else null
The whole response as the server returned it

actions.label: Generate embeddings
actions.description: Turn text into embedding vectors with POST /api/embed. The same input and model give the same vectors.

inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: The model name in model:tag form; the tag defaults to latest. listModels returns what is present.
inputs.builderHint: A name that is not on the server answers 404 and is reported as "not present; pull it first"; nothing is pulled on the caller's behalf. A runner that does not serve embeddings answers 501; showModel lists embedding under capabilities when it does.

inputs.label: Input
inputs.description: Text, or a JSON array of texts, to embed in one call.
inputs.builderHint: A value starting with [ is parsed as the array; one vector comes back per entry, in order.

inputs.label: Truncate
inputs.description: Truncate an input that exceeds the context window instead of failing. The server default is true.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as truncate only when set; false makes an oversized input an error.

outputs.description: One number array per input, in input order
The whole response as the server returned it

actions.label: List models
actions.description: List the models on the server with GET /api/tags.

outputs.description: Array of { name, model, modified_at, size, digest, details }
The whole response as the server returned it

actions.label: Show a model
actions.description: Read a model’s details, capabilities, parameters, template and license with POST /api/show.

inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: The model name in model:tag form; the tag defaults to latest. listModels returns what is present.
inputs.builderHint: A name that is not on the server answers 404 and is reported as "not present; pull it first"; nothing is pulled on the caller's behalf.

inputs.label: Verbose
inputs.description: Include the large fields, such as the full tokenizer, in modelInfo.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as verbose only when true; the reply can run to megabytes.

outputs.description: The model name asked for; the reply carries none
{ parent_model, format, family, families, parameter_size, quantization_level }
Array such as completion, tools, vision, embedding
When the model was last modified, ISO 8601
The whole response as the server returned it

actions.label: List running models
actions.description: List the models loaded into memory with GET /api/ps.

outputs.description: Array of { name, model, size, digest, details, expires_at, size_vram, context_length }
The whole response as the server returned it

actions.label: Get the server version
actions.description: Read the server version with GET /api/version. The live check probes this.

actions.label: Pull a model
actions.description: Download a model from the library with POST /api/pull. Downloads, so it is slow and not repeatable in a live check.

inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: The model name in model:tag form; the tag defaults to latest. listModels returns what is present.
inputs.builderHint: A library name such as gemma3, or user/model for a shared one. A cancelled pull resumes where it left off.

inputs.label: Insecure
inputs.description: Allow downloading over an insecure connection.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as insecure only when true; only for a library you run yourself during development.

outputs.description: The final status, success when the model is present
The whole response as the server returned it

actions.label: Delete a model
actions.description: Delete a model and its data with DELETE /api/delete. A second call answers 404.

inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: The model name in model:tag form; the tag defaults to latest. listModels returns what is present.
inputs.builderHint: Deleting a tag another name was copied from leaves the copy in place; layers are shared.

actions.label: Copy a model
actions.description: Create a new name for an existing model with POST /api/copy. Creates a tag, so it is not repeatable.

inputs.label: Source
inputs.description: Existing model name to copy from.
inputs.builderHint: A missing source answers 404 and is reported as not present.

inputs.label: Destination
inputs.description: New model name to create.
inputs.builderHint: model:tag form; an existing name is overwritten.
